# Recordings of the browser eval live here, one directory per model
# (<model>[+<decide>]/<task>/<run>.json, plus <run>.decide.json for the
# decision model). `eval browser --mode record` writes them. The committed
# sets predate the autocomplete task and the current loop: they are early
# runs, not a baseline — replay of a browser eval is best-effort (see the
# README).
